author: Ronnie
question: How far can a transport law be generated from ordered B2 residuals and their existing response operators, rather than supplied as independent edge rotations?
arithmetic: exact rational matrices; no floating point used for decisions
Core: unchanged note 04, A2(S)=-2S and B2=H plus symmetric trace-free residual
generation: commutators of response operators supply skew generators; on the uniaxial stratum use the isolated rank-one projector and minimal-twist direct rotation
additional_choices: an ordered path of free-number tensors
a common ambient Euclidean frame or reference connection
short projector arcs for finite steps
driver_family: S=a(P-I/3), P real rank-one orthogonal projector, a nonzero; the amplitude and P are recovered from invariants of S
expected_results: response commutators of five independent residual basis tensors span so(3)
forward and reverse projector triangles return all driver tensors but have opposite quarter-turn holonomies
zero-valued cargo has opposite residual-response readouts after these two loops
amplitude changes and subdivisions on the same short arcs do not change generated transport
constant-axis amplitude changes generate identity under the selected geometric rule
zero residual and unsupported spectral families are explicitly rejected, not assigned invented axes
a directly orthogonal projector pair is ambiguous and needs path refinement
a stabilizer counterexample prevents unique transport from compatibility alone
global frame covariance holds; independent local frame covariance needs reference-link data
transforming the reference connection restores local covariance
scope: Conditional generation of transport, plus exact nonuniqueness and reference-data certificates; not a unique law implied by the bare Core, not autonomous generation of the driver path, not physical gauge-field dynamics.
input_construction: prepare_inputs.py specifies free-number tensors from rational directions only to build INPUT.json. The transport generator reads tensors/residuals, never directions or assigned rotation links.
construction_disclosure: Designed analytical examples and expected identities, not blinded predictions.
